notes.title: 🚀 Spice Trade Update: New Game Launcher Added!
notes.notes:
🚀 Update: Spice Trade Gets a Launcher! 🚀
Hello Spice Traders!
We’ve just rolled out a new game launcher for Spice Trade. 🎉

With the launcher, you can:

Access the game more smoothly.

Get notified about updates and patches.

See quick links to our community spaces and future projects here on Steam.

It’s a small step, but it makes the experience cleaner and keeps you connected to what’s next.
[hr][/hr]
🍕 Speaking of what’s next…
We’re excited to also share that our next release is on the horizon: Pizza Syndicate! A cult-classic tycoon from the ’90s, brought back to modern systems. Manage restaurants, hire staff, sabotage rivals, and build your pizza empire with humor and strategy.

👉 Check it out and wishlist Pizza Syndicate today to support the comeback!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4004630/Pizza_Syndicate/"][/dynamiclink]
[hr][/hr]
Thanks for playing Spice Trade and being part of the community—we’re cooking up more for you soon, both in spices… and pizza. 😉


Join Discord! 🍕
